messages:
Eve Martinez: Quick follow-up on the embeddings-index corruption incident. I sketched action items + owner proposals below — please claim/reassign by EOD so we can spin up tickets.
Noah Feldman: Paste the list inline please, will take anything infra/storage related.
Eve Martinez: Condensed action list:
- ITEM-E1: Verify repro for index-corruption during compaction window (owner: Noah, due: 2026-04-04, JIRA: none yet)
- ITEM-E2: Add checksum + repair job for embeddings index on Dedicated nodes (owner: Isha, due: 2026-04-18, JIRA: RED-4107)
- ITEM-E3: Short-term gateway circuit to return 503 + `Retry-After` for impacted tenant groups (owner: Luis, due: 2026-04-07, JIRA: RED-4108)
- ITEM-E4: Cross-incident recurrence analysis and epic proposal (owner: Eve, due: 2026-04-25, JIRA: RED-4109)
- ITEM-E5: Update postmortem doc + RACI matrix + ticket template addition for `temp_owner` (owner: Ops, due: 2026-03-31, no-jira)
Isha Verma: I can own E2. Need the compaction logs and a list of affected shard ids. @Eve where are those?
Eve Martinez: Logs and shard list at s3://pm-artifacts/emb-index/2026-03, shared with Isha & Noah.
Noah Feldman: I'll take E1. Quick repro hint: run the compactor with `--max-pauses=2 --concurrency=8` and use the injected-fault script in `tools/sim/emb-fault.sh`. That produced the corruption locally.
Luis Ortega: For E3 I'll prototype a gateway feature-flagged 503 + `Retry-After` for 60s then ramp via canary. Proposed canary: 30% for 24h. Will add details to RED-4108.
PostmortemBot: Created JIRA RED-4107 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4107)
PostmortemBot: Created JIRA RED-4108 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4108)
PostmortemBot: Created JIRA RED-4109 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4109)
Isha Verma: RACI suggestion: E1 resp=Noah, acct=PlatformLead, consult=StorageEng, informed=PM. E2 resp=Isha, acct=MLInfra, consult=Ops, informed=CS. E3 resp=Luis, acct=InfraLead, consult=ML-eng, informed=Oncall. I'll paste final RACI in the PM doc.
Eve Martinez: One operational ask: add a `recurrence` label when creating these tickets — we saw a similar embedding-only failure in 2025-08. Please cross-link historical PMs.
OpsBot: Ticket template updated: added `temp_owner`, `handoff_contact`, and `recurrence` checkbox.
Luis Ortega: Agreed on cross-linking. I'll add the historical PM links in RED-4109.
Noah Feldman: Can we do a short weekly 10m owners sync until all items are In Progress? Tue 9:30am PT works for me.
Isha Verma: Works for me. Please send invite.
Eve Martinez: Invite sent. Final ask: update JIRA ownership fields and comment `owner-ack` on respective tickets by EOD so Ops can close the loop. I'll update the PM doc with a one-line owner status after each sync. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
